moves.name: WHITEBOARD
moves.text: Oshawott draws a box and some arrows.

moves.name: GOLDEN JUDGE
moves.text: Scheduled LLM-as-judge runs hit a golden dataset! It's super effective!

moves.name: SWARM MIND
moves.text: A multi-agent research team, reasoning UI and all, joins the fight!

moves.name: SELF-BUILD
moves.text: BubblyChef turns an issue into a reviewed PR by itself! 20 merged!

moves.name: LOOK FIRST
moves.text: Ayush's agents pause and show their plan. Humans approve before anything runs!
